$comment: Manual publication decisions for standalone numeric amount pages, keyed by amount entity id. Values: approved | review | excluded. Every approved amount must still clear the automated quality gates; this file can only make the launch set smaller or hold an amount back, and each decision is reviewed against real Search Console data after launch.

rationale.robux-40000: Held at review despite clearing the automated gates. 30,000 and 50,000 already cover the just-above-minimum case, and a third page between them would say substantially the same thing about the same situation. Reassess against real Search Console data rather than publishing three near-identical pages.
rationale.robux-30000: The DevEx minimum itself. Highest explanatory value of any amount because it is the threshold every creator checks first.
rationale.robux-100000: Strong demand across several formatting variants and a common creator milestone.
rationale.robux-1000000: Large, well-searched milestone amount with distinct variants including 1 mil and a million.
rationale.robux-10000000: Distinct upper-range milestone with its own query variants.
rationale.robux-50000: Round milestone with demonstrated demand and a strong how-much query family.
